translations.web: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
translations.bsb: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
